scripts.build: npm --workspace @hanmir/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.build:server: npm --workspace @hanmir/shared run build && npm --workspace @hanmir/server run build
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c "for f in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*.sql; do echo \"== applying $f ==\"; psql -U hanmir -d hanmir_talk -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f $f || exit 1; done"
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U hanmir -d hanmir_talk
